request: Analyze GSE146336 for PMID 32969079 (Thyroid hormone receptor alpha in skeletal muscle is essential for T3-mediated increase in energy expenditure.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq, soleus muscle, male mice (S2.5.p1, S3.3.p1)

genotype: TRa1 HSACre (L400R dominant-negative, 'TRa1 KO' in GEO)

final.sample_inclusion: WT and TRa-HSACre SOL, vehicle n=5-6/4-6, T3 n=5-6/7 (FIG3); GEO has 22 samples (11 WT/11 KO; 9 vehicle/13 T3)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of muscle TRa1 loss-of-function (genotype) on the soleus transcriptome under vehicle, and the T3 response by genotype (S3.3.p1). No exercise factor in the RNA-seq.
planned_contrasts: KO vs WT, vehicle (S3.3.p1/FIG3A; paper: 788 DEGs)
WT-T3 vs KO-T3 (FIG3B/C; GO enrichment, no DEG count)
final.exercise_component: Treadmill exhaustion and 6-week voluntary wheel running were phenotyping endpoints only (S2.4, S3.1.p1, FIG1E/F); no exercised samples were sequenced.

paper_threshold.source_locator: S2.11.p1 (FDR-adjusted P; cutoff assumed 0.05 from P < .05 significance rule)

final.paper_method: edgeR QL, ~0 + group (group = genotype x treatment), contrasts per edgeR manual (S2.6.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.5/S2.6 describe RNA-seq of SOL from WT and TRa-HSACre mice treated with T3 or vehicle; S3.3.p1 reports 788 DEGs KO vs WT. Exercise appears only in S2.4/S3.1 as phenotyping (treadmill capacity, wheel running) of separate cohorts; none of those mice were sequenced.

checks: GEO tissue Soleus muscle, male, genotype WT/TRa1 KO, treatment T3/vehicle matches S3.3.p1

ownership.reasoning: Data availability statement DA.p1 cites GSE146336; metadata factors match the paper's RNA-seq design.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns (033_1 ...) are the prefix of the GEO title ('033_1: Sample 1'); inspect matched 22/22.

matrix.reasoning: All-integer values up to 4.6e6, featureCounts per data_processing and S2.6.p1; paper input is raw counts to edgeR.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: the sequenced samples differ only by genotype (WT vs muscle TRa1 loss-of-function) and treatment (T3 vs vehicle). Exercise (treadmill, wheel running) was a phenotyping readout in unsequenced cohorts (S2.4, S3.1.p1). An exercise effect on gene expression cannot be identified from GSE146336.
design.reasoning: The request is for an exercise effect; GEO grouping columns are only genotype and treatment (T3/vehicle). Running a T3 or genotype contrast would answer a different question than the one asked.

discrepancies.paper: FIG3: vehicle WT/KO n=5-6/4-6, T3 n=5-6/7
